topArticle.title: Storm Charles causes floods and flight cancellations across southern Europe
topArticle.description:
Heavy rain and strong winds have also caused disruption across British Columbia, Canada, over the last week 
Storm Charles has brought destructive weather to the Iberian peninsula this week, particularly in Portugal and the far south of Spain. Heavy rain and strong south-westerly winds arrived first in the Portuguese island of Madeira, before the system headed towards the mainland on 11 November. A wind gust of 84.5mph (136 km/h) was recorded at Funchal airport, alongside rainfall totals reaching 355mm (13.97in) in 12 hours. In Lisbon, 183 flights were cancelled on Wednesday, about a third of its normal daily traffic, while Madrid Barajas airport had 155 cancellations.
After causing widespread flooding in Spain and Portugal, the system moved on a north-easterly track through southern France and then towards northern Italy. This resulted in significant flooding in parts of Cannes, some of which caused rock falls and led to the closure of roads along the French Riviera. The Italian weather service issued a red rainfall warning, its highest level, for the area extending from Tuscany to Venezia. Further heavy rain is expected to fall in Italy and the Balkans over the next few days, with the latest forecast models indicating an additional 100mm could accumulate widely, while totals close to 200mm are likely in more mountainous areas.

topArticle.titleJa: ガボンでのソーシャルメディアアクセス回復は代償を伴う
topArticle.summary: 8ヶ月以上ぶりにガボンでソーシャルメディアアクセスが回復したが、その代償が伴った。

topArticle.title: Boy died from multiple injuries in Cyprus hotel fall
topArticle.description: An Essex coroner describes Jaxon Foster's death as "particularly tragic" as he opens an inquest.
topArticle.titleJa: キプロスのホテル転落で少年が多発性損傷により死亡
topArticle.summary: エセックスの検視官は、キプロスのホテルで少年が転落し死亡したことを「特に悲劇的」と表現し、死因審問を開始しました。

topArticle.title: Russian warship hit by Ukrainian drone in Gulf of Finland
topArticle.description: The attack is thought to be the first time Ukrainian drones have attacked a Russian ship in an open stretch of the Baltic Sea.
topArticle.titleJa: ロシア軍艦、フィンランド湾でウクライナのドローン攻撃を受ける
topArticle.summary: ウクライナのドローンがバルト海でロシア艦船を攻撃したのは、今回が初めてと考えられています。

topArticle.title: Suspected bomb hoax threats force fresh evacuations of Italian schools
topArticle.description: Schools across Italy have received bomb threats for the second day in a row, sparking fresh panic and evacuations.
topArticle.titleJa: 爆弾脅迫の疑いでイタリアの学校が再び避難を余儀なくされる
topArticle.summary: イタリア全土の学校が2日連続で爆弾脅迫を受け、新たなパニックと避難が発生しました。

topArticle.title: Eight killed in Colombian air strike targeting Gulf Clan gang
topArticle.description: A suspected gang leader considered a "priority target" was among those killed, the Colombian president says.
topArticle.titleJa: コロンビア空爆、湾岸氏族ギャングを標的に8人殺害
topArticle.summary: コロンビアで湾岸氏族ギャングを標的とした空爆により8人が死亡。優先標的とされたギャングのリーダーも含まれる。

topArticle.title: Transport workers in Chile block highways in protest over surging fuel prices
topArticle.description: Hundreds of bus and lorry drivers are blocking traffic along major highway routes across the country.
topArticle.titleJa: チリの運輸労働者、燃料価格高騰に抗議して高速道路を封鎖
topArticle.summary: 燃料価格の急騰に抗議し、チリの数百人のバス・トラック運転手が主要高速道路を封鎖。交通に混乱。

topArticle.title: Haitian PM praises El Salvador after joint strike on alleged home of gang leader
topArticle.description: The 400 Mawozo gang was targeted by El Salvador's military, which has deployed thousands of troops to combat Haiti's gang violence crisis.
topArticle.titleJa: ハイチ首相、ギャングリーダー宅とされる場所への共同攻撃後、エルサルバドルを賞賛
topArticle.summary: ハイチ首相がエルサルバドルのギャング対策を称賛。エルサルバドル軍が400マウォゾギャングを標的に攻撃。

topArticle.title: Anti-homosexuality laws in Trinidad and Tobago overturned
topArticle.description: The ruling brings to an end an 11-year legal battle by dual-citizen Jason Jones.
topArticle.titleJa: トリニダード・トバゴの反同性愛法が撤廃される
topArticle.summary: トリニダード・トバゴの反同性愛法が撤廃。11年間の法廷闘争が終結し、重要な人権判決が下された。

topArticle.title: Pope in 'pretty good health' as he starts Latin America tour
topArticle.description: Pope Leo travels to Uruguay just three weeks after having surgery for lung cancer.
topArticle.titleJa: 教皇、ラテンアメリカツアー開始時「かなり健康」
topArticle.summary: 肺がん手術からわずか3週間後、教皇レオがウルグアイへのラテンアメリカツアーを開始。健康状態は良好。

topArticle.title: King relishes 'politically charged' deployments, Palace aide says
topArticle.description: The monarch faced questions on the UK's involvement in the slave trade during his Caribbean tour.
topArticle.titleJa: 国王、「政治色の強い」派遣を喜ぶと宮殿側近が語る
topArticle.summary: カリブ海ツアー中、英国の奴隷貿易への関与について質問された国王が、政治的な議論を歓迎していると側近が発言。

topArticle.title: How medical neglect killed Alfredo Díaz in a Venezuelan cell
topArticle.description: Despite government shifts, a UN report confirms Venezuela's repressive system remains active, documenting how medical neglect in state custody led to the death of regional leader and politician Alfredo Díaz.
topArticle.titleJa: 医療過失によりベネズエラの独房でアルフレド・ディアスが死亡した経緯
topArticle.summary: 国連報告書は、ベネズエラの抑圧的なシステムが活発であり、医療過失が政治家アルフレド・ディアスの死につながったと指摘。

topArticle.title: Ecuadorian youth unite against neoliberal models and state violence
topArticle.description: Thousands of Ecuadorian students have taken to the streets to reject President Noboa’s temporary job plans, demanding permanent solutions for public healthcare, education funding, and rising insecurity.
topArticle.titleJa: エクアドルの若者、新自由主義モデルと国家暴力に団結して反対
topArticle.summary: エクアドルの学生がノボア大統領の臨時雇用計画に反対し、恒久的な医療・教育資金、治安改善を要求。

topArticle.title: Beyond the beaches: The Dominican Republic and the global debate over deep-sea mining
topArticle.description: The DR wanted science to keep advancing and the International Seabed Authority to finish building the regulatory framework that the UN Convention had mandated it to develop.
topArticle.titleJa: ビーチを越えて：ドミニカ共和国と深海採掘をめぐる世界的な議論
topArticle.summary: ドミニカ共和国は、国連海洋法条約が義務付けた深海採掘の規制枠組みの策定を国際海底機構に求めている。

topArticle.title: Clothing factories shut in Bangladesh as workers strike over pay
topArticle.description: Workers are striking over demands for a minimum wage of 30,000 taka (£182) a month.
topArticle.titleJa: バングラデシュで衣料品工場が閉鎖、労働者が賃上げを求めストライキ
topArticle.summary: 労働者たちが月額3万タカの最低賃金を要求しストライキを行っており、バングラデシュの衣料品工場が閉鎖されています。

topArticle.title: At least 24 killed after bus collides with truck in north-east India
topArticle.description: Several of the deceased are college students, according to local official Atul Bora, but they have not yet been publicly identified.
topArticle.titleJa: インド北東部でバスがトラックと衝突、少なくとも24人死亡
topArticle.summary: インド北東部でバスとトラックが衝突し、少なくとも24人が死亡しました。犠牲者の中には大学生も含まれています。

topArticle.title: North Korean hackers used fake video calls in $400m crypto hack, says FBI
topArticle.description: More than 900 victims are thought to have fallen prey to the FaceStealer scheme in the last 18 months.
topArticle.titleJa: 北朝鮮のハッカーが4億ドルの仮想通貨ハッキングに偽ビデオ通話を使用、FBIが発表
topArticle.summary: FBIによると、北朝鮮のハッカーは偽ビデオ通話を利用して4億ドルの仮想通貨ハッキングを行い、多数の被害者が出ています。

topArticle.title: Indonesia's vice-president resigns amid signs ruling alliance is fraying
topArticle.description: The news comes at a turbulent time for President Prabowo, who faces a growing rift with his predecessor Joko Widodo.
topArticle.titleJa: インドネシア副大統領が辞任、与党連合に亀裂の兆候
topArticle.summary: インドネシアの副大統領が辞任しました。与党連合内で亀裂が生じており、プラボウォ大統領は困難な時期に直面しています。

topArticle.title: How the Jensen Huang scandal created a headache for business-friendly Singapore
topArticle.description: The scandal has cast a spotlight on Singapore's success as a chip hub - and a location for alleged illicit trade.
topArticle.titleJa: ジェンセン・ファン・スキャンダルがビジネスに優しいシンガポールに頭痛の種をどのように生み出したか
topArticle.summary: ジェンセン・ファン・スキャンダルがシンガポールのチップハブとしての成功と、不法貿易の拠点としての地位に注目を集めています。

topArticle.title: Ireland contributes EUR 200,000 to strengthen trade opportunities in developing countries
topArticle.description: Ireland is contributing EUR 200,000 (approximately CHF 185,000) to the Standards and Trade Development Facility (STDF) in 2026 to strengthen sanitary and phytosanitary capacity in developing and least-developed countries. The contribution will support STDF activities that help countries meet international food safety and animal and plant health standards, as well as facilitate safe and inclusive trade.
topArticle.titleJa: アイルランド、途上国の貿易機会強化に20万ユーロを貢献
topArticle.summary: アイルランドは、途上国の衛生植物検疫能力強化のため、STDFに20万ユーロを拠出し、安全な貿易を促進します。

topArticle.title: South Africa notifies launch of safeguard investigation into certain non-wired float glass products
topArticle.description: On 11 November 2026, South Africa notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards regarding the initiation on 3 November 2026 of a safeguard investigation into imports of certain non-wired float glass products.
topArticle.titleJa: 南アフリカ、一部の非有線フロートガラス製品に対するセーフガード調査の開始を通知
topArticle.summary: 南アフリカは、一部の非有線フロートガラス製品の輸入に関するセーフガード調査の開始をWTOに通報しました。

topArticle.title: EU launches safeguard investigation on certain PET resin chemicals
topArticle.description: On 6 November 2026, the European Union notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated, on the same day (6 November 2026), a safeguard investigation on imports of certain polyethylene terephthalate resin chemicals.
topArticle.titleJa: EU、特定のPET樹脂化学品に関するセーフガード調査を開始
topArticle.summary: EUは、特定のポリエチレンテレフタレート樹脂化学品の輸入に対し、セーフガード調査の開始をWTOに通報しました。

topArticle.title: Trade Policy Review: Viet Nam
topArticle.description: The third review of the trade policies and practices of Viet Nam takes place on 4 and 6 November 2026. The basis for the review is a report by the WTO Secretariat and a report by the Government of Viet Nam.
topArticle.titleJa: 貿易政策レビュー：ベトナム
topArticle.summary: ベトナムの貿易政策と慣行に関する第3回レビューが、WTO事務局とベトナム政府の報告書に基づき実施されます。

topArticle.title: Working Party chair visits Uzbekistan as WTO accession negotiations enter critical phase
topArticle.description: A WTO delegation led by Ambassador Sung-yo Choi of the Republic of Korea, chair of the Working Party on the Accession of Uzbekistan, visited Tashkent, Uzbekistan, from 1 to 3 November to support Uzbekistan's preparations for WTO accession as its negotiations enter a critical phase. The visit included high-level consultations with government officials on outstanding issues across the accession process and exchanges with international development partners and the academic community.
topArticle.titleJa: 作業部会委員長がウズベキスタンを訪問、WTO加盟交渉は重要な段階に入る
topArticle.summary: WTO加盟作業部会委員長がウズベキスタンを訪問し、加盟交渉が重要な局面に入る中、準備を支援しました。
